# Renthob

> Renthob is a rental-property discovery and listing platform for renters, landlords, and agents in Nigeria.

## Public pages

- [Browse properties](https://renthob.com/search): Search active rental listings by location, budget, property type, and amenities.
- [Rental advisor](https://renthob.com/advisor): Describe rental requirements in plain language and see matching active listings.
- [How Renthob works](https://renthob.com/how-it-works): Steps for renters, landlords, and agents.
- [Features](https://renthob.com/features): Currently available platform features.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://renthob.com/faqs): Account, listing, and renter guidance.
- [Contact](https://renthob.com/contact): Renthob support details.
- [Privacy policy](https://renthob.com/privacy): How Renthob handles personal information.
- [Terms of service](https://renthob.com/terms): Rules for using Renthob.
